posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
dclietz:

Absolute Zero – Make “Focused Apertures” a module. Also, buff the base power to deal 2 damage

Expatriette – Buff speed loading to play the ammo directly to the gun.

Mr. Fixer – Combine “Riveting Crane” and “Alternating Tiger Claw” effects. Create a new style with the open slot, for example “the first time each turn Mr. Fixer deals damage, Mr. Fixer deals one target one melee damage”Nightmist – Change DW promo to draw 3 then put 3

Captain Cosmic – Change the prime wardens promo to “until the next time you use a power” so it combos with his own destroy construct card

I'm picking and choosing a few from your buffs.   I like the idea of the Apertures being a module but I don't think AZ needs a damage buff to his base power.   With that out he is already healing two or dealing two from his base power.   For Expat I'm not sure how this is a buff.  Are you suggesting the ammo from trash gets played immediately onto a gun?   For Mr Fixer the new style you suggest works a bit like Dual Crowbars and so I would suggest instead a style that lets him destroy an ongoing or environment card if he destroys a target.   Lastly, with Captain Cosmic I'm not sure I follow how that lets you do combos.

dclietz:

The Scholar – Maybe limit Flesh To Iron to once each turn. 

The constant discard for The Scholar to keep that in play is enough regular cost that I don't feel it deserves a nerf.

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked: Also, Legacy buffing everyone is, itself, as much a risk as it is a boon. The indiscriminate buffing means that Nightmist is hurting herself more for every card and her base power, Tachyon has a harder time keeping Pushing the Limits out, Golem Unity's practically killing herself with her base power, etc.

posts.name: dclietz
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

For Expat I'm not sure how this is a buff.  Are you suggesting the ammo from trash gets played immediately onto a gun… with Captain Cosmic I'm not sure I follow how that lets you do combos.

Yeah, with Expat I was suggesting it playing one ammo per turn from trash to gun, skipping the top of your deck. Currently Speed Loading prevents you from drawing a new card when you use it.

With Cosmic, right now the effect wears off at the start of your turn, so if you play for example "Potent Disruption" on your turn it won't trigger it. I'm suggesting tweaking the timing so that it does.

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
PePe QuiCoSE:

Oh, there is a card I did change, print and sleeve the deck. It's the Amulet from Nightmist deck to only redirect Infernal damage.

Why? That upends half of her whole strategy, and makes any kind of type-changing into a game-killer.

posts.name: PePe QuiCoSE
posts.cooked:
Well, it's thematic, as said. That is a big plus for me. It makes a lot of sense having the Amulet redirect one of her spell's damage but not as much redirecting a T-Rex or a collapsing Train. And it also makes sense that the Amulet is more powerful when fighting guys that do Infernal Damage, like Apostate or Gloomy.

But also because it's half of her whole strategy. It overshadows other great cards she has in her deck. Draw cards, play stuff here and there util you draw the Amulet gets old after some games. This change forces you to be less lazy with Nighmist and more creative/reactive. Other powers like Astral Projection or the Book make more sense if you can't redirect that damage off from yourself. Still the Amulet is your main offensive buff. In general it takes Nightmist away from Tank and more into Damage/Support.

Of course, the other option was to play DW Nightmist, but I do like her main version a lot more.
